title: History / s
description: Seconds of play kept below the now line during gameplay (5–60). A further fifth of that previews the upcoming map density above it.

title: Graph length / px
description: Length of the vertical chart beside the stage (240–760 px). Song select caps it to fit its centre column.

title: Show strain backdrop
description: Draw the map's difficulty strain (vosu performance graph) as a faint silhouette behind the trace, aligned to map time.

title: Gameplay side
description: Which side of the mania stage the strip floats on. Right keeps clear of the HP bar.

title: Gameplay alignment
description: stage = float just beside the stage, measured from your skin's skin.ini through vosu. centre = middle of the empty band on that side.

title: ColumnStart override
description: 0 = read from your skin. Otherwise osu!stable skin.ini [Mania] ColumnStart, for when vosu cannot serve the skin (lazer built-in skins, tosu). Ignored on lazer, which centres the stage.

title: ColumnWidth override
description: 0 = read from your skin. Otherwise one skin.ini ColumnWidth for every column, to size the stage when the skin cannot be read.

title: Nudge X / px
description: Moves the gameplay strip horizontally (negative = left).

title: Nudge Y / px
description: Moves the gameplay strip vertically (negative = up).

title: Backing
description: none = floats on the game. scrim = a soft dark glow behind it that fades out. panel = the 18-LAB graphite panel.

title: Accent
description: map = peak and live marks take the current map's colour (from its background, never shown). 18-lab = amber.

title: Show 18—LAB tag
description: The small brand tag above the readouts.
